title: LinkWhatsappFollows
description: plinth.link_whatsapp_follows/1, from api.link_whatsapp_follows(p_accept) ("Bring them here", API_CONTRACTS §3.2; built by T45a). The WhatsApp number is the account's own verified phone. p_accept false is the peek before any tap: what that number follows on WhatsApp, nothing changes. p_accept true is the buyer's own tap: the WhatsApp contact is linked to the account and its follows move into the account (source whatsapp); the answer lists the follows now brought. A number linked to another account answers linked false with nothing listed.

accepted.description: Echoes p_accept: true only for the "Bring them here" tap.

linked.description: This WhatsApp number is linked to the caller's account now.

follows.description: Peek: the number's WhatsApp follows not brought yet. Accepted: the follows brought into the account. Oldest first.

cost_sheets.description: Cost sheets the number saved on WhatsApp (uploads, M3). Empty until uploads exist.

since.description: The IST date the number followed it on WhatsApp.
